text:
Ashley: Heads up — procurement is evaluating LumeLedger + SpendGrid for an invoice reconciliation POC. Need clear answers on CSV schema, bulk import APIs, SSO/SCIM, and any rate limits. Any immediate red flags?

Mike: Those are the two we demoed earlier, right? I remember LumeLedger had funky rate limiting on large backfills.

Priya: I spun up SpendGrid last week for a quick test. API looks fine, but the UI can only backfill 90 days. No UI backfill for >90 days — need a bulk API call.

Finance-bot: Reminder: attach estimated MRR impact to vendor requests. Anything under $5k/mo can be approved by managers.

procurement: looping in the vendor rep — @vendor-rep can you confirm whether SpendGrid exposes a bulk import endpoint and what the CSV schema is?

vendor-rep: Hi all — yes, SpendGrid supports bulk ingest via POST /v1/imports and accepts gzipped CSV. Sample schema attached in docs: https://spendgrid.example/docs/imports.

vendor-rep: Example curl to import:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.spendgrid.example/v1/imports \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \n  -F "file=@invoices.csv.gz" \n  -F "mapping=account_id,invoice_id,amount,currency,date"
```

Ashley: Thanks — can you confirm SAML IdP compatibility? We run Okta and expect SCIM provisioning. Also need group sync for billing sub-orgs.

vendor-rep: We support SAML SSO + SCIM for user provisioning. SCIM currently maps users by email; group sync (roles/groups) is not GA yet.

Priya: Group sync is important for us to separate cost centers. Is group sync on your roadmap or a paid feature?

vendor-rep: Group sync is on the roadmap for Q2 (ETA mid-June). We can share early access for pilots — might be behind an enterprise toggle.

Mike: Pricing models? We need per-invoice pricing vs. flat monthly for TCO. Any example calc for high-volume usage?

vendor-rep: Standard: $0.10 per processed invoice + $500/mo baseline for premium support. Connectors — first 3 included, others $200/connector/mo.

procurement: For comparison, LumeLedger's current quote shows $400/mo + $0.02 per invoice after 100k. We should validate both including addons.

Ashley: Quick napkin TCO at projected 200k invoices/year: SpendGrid = 200k * $0.10 + $500*12 = $20,000 + $6,000 = $26,000/yr. LumeLedger = $400*12 + (200k - 100k)*$0.02 = $4,800 + $2,000 = $6,800/yr. That delta seems large — are we missing hidden fees?

Priya: LumeLedger noted a reconciliation AI add-on at $8k/yr and premium support at higher tiers. Map SLA differences before deciding.

vendor-rep: Also factor integration costs — SpendGrid includes 3 connectors in the base plan; additional connectors $200/mo each. We also offer a managed-import service ($1k one-time) to speed onboarding.

Mike: Operational requirements: we need <2s per transaction for reconciliation calls used in checkout flows. What are your latencies for real-time endpoints?

vendor-rep: Real-time reconciliation endpoints average 300–800ms depending on payload size and region. We have EU region endpoints as well.

procurement: Can you provide sandbox credentials + sample CSV? Also need SOC2 and data residency info for legal.

vendor-rep: Sending sandbox token via DM. Sample CSV: https://s3.example/samples/spendgrid-sample.csv. SOC2 Type II and EU data residency available (EU region is opt-in, may incur a small surcharge).

Ashley: @Legal — can you confirm if SOC2 + EU option passes our requirements? Also any PII constraints?

Legal: SOC2 Type II is acceptable. For EU residency we need a Data Processing Addendum and an assurance of customer-controlled keys if required. No high-risk PII should be stored unencrypted — vendor confirmed encryption at rest.

procurement: Next steps proposal: run parallel 2-week POCs with both vendors. Evaluate: integration time, error rate on ingestion, latency for reconciliation calls, TCO over 1–3 years, and support responsiveness. Assign POC owners.

Ashley: I'll lead the LumeLedger POC.

Priya: I'll take SpendGrid and target ingest + basic reconciliation tests by EOD Friday.

Mike: I'll measure endpoint latency and put a small load test together. Will coordinate with eng-ops for any infra creds.

Finance-bot: PO threshold reminder: POs > $10k require director sign-off.

procurement: Noted. We'll keep POC spend under the threshold for initial tests. If we need sandbox expansions, we'll route for approval.

Priya: Vendor rep — one ask: can you include a brief CSV with nested line-item rows to test our parser?

vendor-rep: Uploaded an extended sample to the same bucket: https://s3.example/samples/spendgrid-extended.csv. If you hit issues ping me and I can walk through the mapping.

Ashley: Cool — thanks everyone. Will post a short status update next Tues. :thumbsup:

Mike: +1

Priya: Got it, starting now.

procurement: Thanks — we'll track approvals and potential contract terms in the vendor scorecard doc.

Legal: If POC goes well, I'll start a checklist for DPA and KMS requirements.

vendor-rep: Happy to help — reach out anytime.

Ashley: Closing thread for now, will reopen with POC results. :white_check_mark:
